test_title: PYST 138: SSC GD Constable - English (Held On - 30 Jan,, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word in the given sentence.**

Nothing equalled the **__grief__** I felt at the death of my pet cat.
solution: The correct answer is **"Anguish."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Grief"** means great sadness (especially because of the death of somebody you love). (गहरा शोक (विशेषतः किसी प्रिय के निधन से उत्‍पन्‍न)) • **Example**: *Newspapers should not intrude on people's private **grief**__.* • Synonym of **"grief"** is **"anguish."** • **"Anguish"** means extreme sadness or suffering. (गहरी वेदना या पीड़ा; मनोव्‍यथा) __ • **Example**: *The **anguish**__ of losing a loved one can be unbearable.* • The correct answer is Option 4. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Option 1, Freedom**, means the power or right to act, speak, or think as one wants. (स्‍वतंत्रता, आज़ादी; दूसरे की क़ैद या नियंत्रण से मुक्ति) • **Option 2, Bondage**, means the state of being a slave or being greatly restricted by circumstances. (गुलाम होने की अवस्था या परिस्थितियों द्वारा अत्यधिक प्रतिबंधित होना) • **Option 3, Fear**, means an unpleasant emotion caused by the threat of danger, pain, or harm. (भय, डर) 33:Tafe, The correct answer is **"stared."**
